card.name: Frequency and rate units being spelled
card.fires_on: Partway through a frequency or rate expression, such as the G in a number-G-Hz range, or the ah in megahertz or gigahertz. It also fires on digits inside frequency or rate figures, just before Hz, kHz or fps.

modes.label: Hertz prefix spelling
modes.description: The unit prefix before Hz is being written out, either as a hyphenated G or as the middle of megahertz or gigahertz.
modes.example: The first part of the signal vibrates at 600 to 2500 meg<<ah>>ertz.

modes.label: Digits before a rate unit
modes.description: A digit inside a frequency or rate number that is followed by Hz, kHz or fps.

card.writes: It promotes odd fragments such as azz, zo and za, and suppresses Oh and OH, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of frequency figures such as gigahertz or 44 kHz, just before the unit is completed.
